text: Grace, a former foster child, marries Alex into the wealthy Le Domas family, whose games fortune came from [a great-grandfather's deal with a mysterious Le Bail|origin|bargains with dark powers]. At midnight on her wedding night she draws a card from his puzzle box, and it reads Hide-and-Seek. In the locked mansion the in-laws [each take up a weapon|images|weapons and tools], sure they must [sacrifice her before dawn|wants|the sacrifice demanded] or die themselves, and Grace, hunted from room to room, falls into [a pit of earlier sacrifices|images|corpses and body parts].
